title: KITAB-Bench: A Comprehensive Multi-Domain Benchmark for Arabic OCR and Document Understanding
reasoning: The paper is a technical benchmark for Arabic Optical Character Recognition (OCR) and document understanding tasks. It evaluates models on their ability to extract text from various document formats (charts, tables, etc.). While the dataset includes diverse topics to ensure breadth, it does not evaluate religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a core component of the study.
